answer: We conceptualize decentralized peer validation through a bio-inspired immune network where coordinated Sybil payloads function as antigens, triggering an exponential increase in consensus resistance. This adaptive defense employs a beacon of cryptographic truth to anchor global state, while a jetty of isolated filtering shards prevents contagion, distilling trust like a rare pearl from noise.
